description: Daily motivation messages for the planning dashboard. Warm, short, no pressure or blame, and never a promise of a specific grade. '{name}' is optional and replaced with the student's first name (or removed).

messages.text: Every question you try today teaches you something, even the ones you get wrong.
Small steps still move you forward. One focused session is enough to start.
You don't have to feel ready to begin. Starting is what makes you ready.
Hard topics feel hard because you're growing. That's a good sign, {name}.
Curiosity beats perfection. Ask yourself why, not just what.
Twenty honest minutes on a tricky topic is worth more than an hour of skimming.
Mistakes on practice questions are free lessons. Collect as many as you can.
Your effort today is a gift to the you who sits the exam.
Pick one thing to understand a little better today. That counts.
Learning chemistry is like building a wall: one brick at a time, and each one matters.
If a problem stops you, try explaining it out loud. You know more than you think.
Give today's session your full attention, then let yourself rest properly.
It's okay to go slowly. Understanding lasts longer than rushing.
You showed up today, {name}. That's the most important part.
Write down one thing you learned at the end of your session. Watch the list grow.
Being stuck is part of studying, not a sign you can't do it.
A little every day adds up to a lot. Keep your steady rhythm going.
Routine is your quiet superpower. Same time, same place, one session at a time.
You don't need a perfect day, just a regular one.
Showing up again is how big progress is built, {name}.
Short, regular revision helps your memory more than long, rare sessions.
Keep the chain going: one session today keeps tomorrow easier.
Your plan works best when you follow it gently, not perfectly.
Each session you finish makes the next one feel more natural.
Steady beats intense. Look after your energy so you can keep going.
Coming back to a topic a few days later is how it sticks. Your plan does that for you.
Habits are built on ordinary days like today.
A calm, regular pace is a strong pace. Keep it up, {name}.
You're building something every week, even when it doesn't feel like it.
Start your session at the planned time and let the routine carry you.
Little and often. That's the whole secret.
Every regular day of study makes the exam feel a little more familiar.
Missed a session? That's okay. Today is a fresh start.
One tough result doesn't define you. It just shows where to look next.
Life gets busy. Your plan has already made room for what you missed.
Be kind to yourself today, {name}. Progress isn't a straight line.
A dip in marks is information, not a judgement. Let's use it.
You don't have to catch up all at once. One session gets you moving again.
Every strong student has off days. What matters is coming back.
Start small today: one short session on one topic is a real win.
Reviewing mistakes is brave work. You're doing the part that helps most.
It's never too late to pick things up again. Welcome back, {name}.
Rest was maybe what you needed. Now let's take the next small step.
A topic that feels shaky today can feel solid after a few focused sessions.
Your plan has adjusted, so you don't need to worry about the past few days.
Breathe, pick one task, and begin. That's enough for now.
Getting back on track is a skill, and you're practising it right now.
You're allowed to start again as many times as you need.
This week, revise what you know and trust the work you've already done.
Calm and steady wins this week. Sleep well, eat well, revise gently.
No need to learn everything new now. Strengthen what you already have, {name}.
Past papers today are practice for staying calm on the day.
Take short breaks between sessions. A rested mind remembers more.
Look back at how much you've covered. You've come a long way.
Focus on one paper at a time and one question at a time.
Nervous feelings are normal. They mean you care. Breathe slowly and begin.
Quick revision of your notes is perfect for this week. Keep it light and regular.
Prepare your things the night before so the morning can be calm.
You've done the learning. This week is about confidence and rest, {name}.
If a question looks hard on the day, move on and come back. That's good exam skill.
Go easy on yourself this week. Steady revision is exactly right.
Read each question carefully. Calm reading saves marks.
A good night's sleep is part of your revision plan this week.
Whatever happens, your effort over these months is something to be proud of.
What a week! You followed your plan really well. Enjoy that feeling.
Your steady work is showing, {name}. Well done.
You kept your promises to yourself this week. That's worth celebrating.
Great consistency! Take a moment to notice how far you've come.
You did the work, even on busy days. Be proud of that.
Strong week! Reward yourself with a proper rest today.
Your dedication this week has been brilliant. Keep enjoying the journey.
Look at that progress, {name}! Small sessions really do add up.
You turned plans into action this week. That's a real skill.
Well done for staying on track. Share your win with someone today.
Your effort is paying off in how confidently you're working.
A week like this is something to remember on harder days.
You've built a great rhythm. Keep it going at a pace that feels good.
Nice work this week! Every finished session was a step forward.
You should feel proud of how well you studied this week, {name}.
Celebrate the effort, not just the results. You've earned it.
